construction_semantics: ordered ADX_ONLY selection; equal weight equals one divided by actual selected count; cash equals one minus gross weight
historical_research_boundary_source: final end_date in the verified Phase 8 frozen temporal partition
immutability_rules: protocol semantic fields are immutable after activation
formations, positions, maturity events, outcomes, and audit events are append-only
a semantic rule change requires a new protocol version and fingerprint
formation_rule: one immutable formation per newly completed VNINDEX session strictly after both historical and operational activation cutoffs
maturity_rule: horizon h matures only at the exact h-th later completed VNINDEX session
no_backfill_invariant: formations at or before the historical boundary or operational activation cutoff are rejected; missed sessions become audit gaps only
operational_activation_cutoff_semantics: latest completed canonical VNINDEX session explicitly acknowledged at activation; formations must be strictly later
